title: Q-AUDIT-CONVERGE-1: one shared audit implementation for seed audit_log (AUDIT-CHAIN-1) and core/audit (AUDIT-1)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** file:workers/core/audit/audit.test.js
**Status:** done

Two audit logs landed the same day: the seed worker's audit chain (#588, Ultrastable's own runtime, sealed segments to R2 or the ops repo) and workers/core/audit (#586, tenant-agnostic, used by tenants such as Practical Solutions). Converge so one hash-chain, Merkle and roll-up implementation remains and the other imports it. Done: seed/worker/src/auditchain.js imports sha256 and Merkle from workers/core/audit; one implementation remains. Closing probe: grep finds a single event-hash and Merkle implementation; both test suites pass.
